en: "Oh, Momotaro! It's been a long time!"{KP}"Uhyahya...! I am the {bb}Cooking Hermit{ww}!"{KP}"What's that? You want me to teach you the {bb}Cooking art{ww} once more?"{KP}"Very well! Bring me my favorite food, and I'll grant you this art!"{KP}"Here's a hint: it's a sweeet fish that doesn't live in the sea!"{KP}"Uhyahya...! I'll be waiting!"

jp:
「ウヒャヒャ…！
　料理の　コツは
　材料を　うまく　使うことじゃ！」
en: "Uhyahya...! The secret to cooking is making good use of your ingredients!"

jp:
桃太郎は
{bb}{MM}{ww}を　わたした！

「おお　桃太郎！
　よくぞ　持ってきてくれたのォ！」
　{KP}
「ウヒャヒャ…！　では
　{bb}りょうりの術{ww}を　授けよう！」
en: "Oh, Momotaro! You've done well to bring it!"{KP}"Uhyahya...! Now, I shall grant you the {bb}Cooking art{ww}!"

jp:
桃太郎は
{bb}りょうりの術{ww}を　覚えた！

「うまく　使いこなすのぢゃぞ！
　桃太郎よ！」

「これは　何かな…？
　わしは　まだ　何も
　言っておらんぞ！」
en: "What's this...? I haven't said anything yet!"
